title: Consumption
description: The raw quantities one step used or is expected to use. Nothing here is converted into money: money follows from these quantities and a versioned price table, and the normalised Takt from the same quantities and a weighting table (docs/architecture/accounting.md). At least one quantity is present. compute_seconds is meaningless without its resource_class.

quantities.title: ConsumptionQuantities
quantities.description: The measurable quantities, without closure, so that other schemas can extend them.

tokens_in.description: Language-model input tokens, of every price kind: uncached input, input read from a cache and input written to one. tokens_by_model splits the same total by model and price kind.

tokens_out.description: Language-model output tokens, reasoning included where the model reasons: a provider bills reasoning as output.

quota_units.description: Units of a subscription window, in the unit the worker declares in its capabilities.

compute_seconds.description: Seconds of compute held, in the given resource class.

currencyAmounts.title: CurrencyAmounts
currencyAmounts.description: Money by ISO 4217 code in lowercase, for example {"eur": 3.2}. A map rather than a fixed currency so that no currency is baked into the contract.

resourceClass.title: ResourceClass
resourceClass.description: A class of compute, named by the operator: cpu.small, gpu.small, accelerator.large. The weighting table maps classes to Takt.

tokensByModel.title: TokensByModel
tokensByModel.description: Language-model tokens per model and per price kind, so that money is computable from what is recorded (ADR-0010): a price table prices each kind of each model, and the same breakdown feeds the Takt. The key is the model as the endpoint named it when it answered — the name the provenance records. input is uncached input; cache_read is input read from a cache; cache_write is input written to one; output is output, reasoning included. The four input-side and output-side sums over all models equal tokens_in and tokens_out where those are present.

priceKinds.title: PriceKinds
priceKinds.description: Tokens of one model, by the kinds a provider prices differently. At least one kind is present.

priceKindName.title: PriceKindName
priceKindName.description: One of the kinds of token a provider prices differently.
